_comment: Copy this file to ticket_guilds.json and replace every value with the real id from YOUR server. Keys are Discord server (guild) ids. A server that is not listed here cannot open or manage tickets. Category keys: tickets, billing, support, partnership, recruitment, active, outdated, followup. The panel_* keys are the wording of that server's public ticket panel (use \n for line breaks).

000000000000000000.name: First server
000000000000000000.panel_description: Create a ticket and our team will assist you. Our staff will identify your request and route your ticket to the appropriate department.

000000000000000001.name: Second server
000000000000000001.panel_description: Open a ticket here and this server's team will help you.
